name: search_posts_and_open_result
description: Search the WordPress site at http://localhost:8000/ using a query string and open the first matching result or a specified post by ID. Steps: navigate to base search URL, enter query into the search input (input[name='s'] or input[type='search']), submit the search (form[role='search'] [type='submit'] or button[type='submit']), wait for results, optionally click a result link (by post id or by first match). Returns the opened post URL and list of result links.

steps.description: Navigate directly to the search results URL constructed with the provided query. Using URL navigation avoids relying on UI interactions to perform the search and is deterministic.
Wait for the search results page to load.
Collect all candidate post result links from the results page; helpful for returning results and choosing which to open.
steps.goal: Extract list of anchors matching WordPress post links (href contains '?p=') and their visible texts and hrefs

steps.description: Agentic selection is used because the target element may be in different containers (sidebar, main content).
steps.task: Select which result to open: if {post_id} provided, choose the anchor with href containing '?p={post_id}'. Else choose the first anchor from 'search_results'.

steps.description: If post_id provided, click the anchor whose href contains the post_id to open that post (first match).
Click the selected search result to open the post page.
steps.task: If post_id not provided, click the first anchor from 'search_results' collected earlier and save its href as opened_post_url.

steps.description: Wait for the post page to navigate and load.
Retrieve the title and URL of the opened post to return to caller.
steps.goal: Extract post page title and URL to confirm the navigation and provide final output

input_schema.name: query
input_schema.description: Search query string to send to the site's search input (e.g., 'Microsoft Planner tips').

input_schema.name: post_id
input_schema.description: Optional post id to open (e.g., '8'). If omitted, the tool will open the first search result link it finds.

input_schema.name: base_url
input_schema.description: Base site URL. Defaults to 'http://localhost:8000/'. Use if testing on a different host or port.
